messages:
maria-partnerships: Need a quick partner enablement pack for Azure + GCP marketplace. Scope: reference architecture, Terraform modules (provider-specific), example one-click templates, and minimal CI smoke tests. Target: initial PR by next Thurs. Who can take module scaffolding and sample deploys?
kevin-solutions: I can take the TF modules. Proposal: separate modules per cloud to avoid provider gymnastics, plus a tiny common docs repo. Required features: private VPC, KMS/HSM key wiring, GPU SKU param, optional autoscaler. Any objections?
olivia-eng-platform: Separate modules sounds cleaner. I'll own the ref-architecture doc and diagram (PlantUML). Will include two patterns: single-zone GPU pool + multi-region fallback.
sachin-cloud-eng: Note: marketplace VM images need driver/kernel hints and GCP licensing metadata; I'll add startup scripts and a small `metadata` block. Example for GCP: 
```hcl
module "redwood_gcp_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-templates//modules/gcp"
  project = var.project
  region  = var.region
  machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g"
  node_image = "gcr.io/redwood-inference/ubuntu-gpu:latest"
  kms_key = var.kms_key
}
```
kevin-solutions: For Azure I'll include a sample `azurerm_linux_virtual_machine` with `Standard_NC6s_v3`. Outputs: `endpoint_url`, `load_balancer_ip`, `instance_ids`. Also adding network policy to allow only partner IP ranges + private endpoints.
jen-marketing: Marketing needs: 1-slide arch diagram, 2 screenshots (deploy + console), and a 2-3 sentence partner blurb. Can engineering provide a stable example snapshot by EOD Tuesday? :pray: 
maria-partnerships: Timeline: Olivia refarch by Tue, Kevin open TF scaffold PR by Wed, Sachin add startup/kernel notes + smoke test, Jen preps blurb and slides. Maria will handle partner/legal questions.
kevin-solutions: Repo plan: `github.com/redwood-inference/partner-templates`. Branch `feat/scaffold-marketplace`. CI: GH Actions matrix for GCP/Azure to deploy into ephemeral test accounts, run a `/healthz` curl and teardown. Smoke test script will be included.
packaging-bot: packaging-bot: New branch created: `feat/scaffold-marketplace` (CI triggered)
maria-partnerships: Add `reference-variables.md` and `security-considerations.md` to repo. Security should include dataflow bullets for marketplace listings. Who will write those?
olivia-eng-platform: I'll write `reference-variables.md`. Maria, can you draft dataflow bullets for legal review and we can slot them into `security-considerations.md`?
sachin-cloud-eng: For smoke tests I'll add a tiny bash playbook: SSH to instance, verify NVIDIA drivers, run a local inference curl. Example: 
```bash
# smoke test
ssh -i $KEY ubuntu@$IP "nvidia-smi && curl -sS http://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{\\"prompt\\":\\"test\\"}'"
```
kevin-solutions: PR checklist: module README, `examples/` with `main.tf` + `terraform.tfvars`, `vars.tf` with defaults, `outputs.tf`, GH Action smoke test. I'll tag Olivia and Sachin on reviews.
jen-marketing: Also request a screenshot of the console showing role-based access + cost telemetry; helps marketplace listing.
maria-partnerships: Will coordinate with infra for example creds and partner contacts. After PR merges, we'll schedule a partner demo. Tentative demo: next Friday.
kevin-solutions: Quick question: should we manage model optimization (quantization) in infra modules or keep it separate?
olivia-eng-platform: Keep infra focused. Put one `examples/optimized/` that demonstrates passing `quantization_profile` into runtime config, but not as a default var.
sachin-cloud-eng: Agreed. I'll mention supported quant libs in README and how runtime picks them up from instance files.
packaging-bot: GitHub Actions: 2/2 checks passed for `feat/scaffold-marketplace`
kevin-solutions: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-templates/pull/7 1 files7. Requesting review from @olivia-eng-platform and @sachin-cloud-eng.
maria-partnerships: Thanks all. If any partner packaging or marketplace certification questions pop up, flag them here and I'll loop in partner reps.
kevin-solutions: Will follow up with PR links to example deploy logs.
jen-marketing: Blocking: legal needs the dataflow bullets before we send listing assets. Maria, ping when ready.
maria-partnerships: Will ping legal today and update the repo. Meeting Friday 10am to review demo and final checklist. :thumbsup:
